code:
$ ps aux | grep nginx
root      1142  0.0  0.3  12144  3012 ?  Ss  09:02  nginx: master
www-data  1143  0.0  0.4  12516  4420 ?  S   09:02  nginx: worker

$ top        # live, refreshing view
$ htop       # friendlier live view, if installed
caption: Every running program is a process with a unique PID — PID 1 is systemd itself.

steps.label: kill <pid>
steps.sub: sends SIGTERM — a polite request, the process cleans up first

steps.label: kill -9 <pid>
steps.sub: sends SIGKILL — immediate, no cleanup; last resort only

code:
$ systemctl status sshd
● ssh.service - active (running)

$ sudo systemctl restart sshd
$ sudo systemctl enable sshd    # starts on every future boot
$ sudo systemctl disable sshd   # no longer starts on boot
caption: Every service, same commands — status, start/stop/restart, enable/disable.

steps.label: Parallel startup
steps.sub: independent services boot together, not one at a time

steps.label: Unit files
steps.sub: one consistent .service format instead of bespoke scripts
